description: Having grown up chopping cotton as a child in the Mississippi Delta, I use my story and experience as an example of what exposure to social, cultural, and economic capital can lead to.The Mississippi Delta still remains one of the most poverty-stricken and deprived regions in the country. That poverty affects no one more than youths living in underserved communities scattered throughout the Delta.
